title: long-training-archive
description: The 24 long training scenes packed losslessly (fields.zip, 2.8 GB), and the project files the two guided models were trained from. Prepared by: experiments/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/pack_long_training_candidate_v1.py; experiments/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/prepare_guided_shared_project_v1.py; experiments/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/prepare_guided_pressure_project_v1.py. Built from: long-trajectories (train split). Settings: docs/plans/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/long-training-transport-protocol-01.json; docs/plans/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/guided-shared-Project-preparation-protocol-01.json; docs/plans/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/guided-pressure-Project-preparation-protocol-01.json. Computed with the weights of: recurrent-sampler-head-01; expanded-shared-spectral-01; b1-fixed-viscosity; mixed-modal-pair-11 (their weights are in the model-source package). The earlier account gives the command as recorded at the time: 'pack_long_training_candidate_v1.py --protocol <transport settings> --output runs/full-ai-data-diversity-v1/long-training-transport-01; then each project script with --protocol <its settings file>'. The archive was written to /tmp and the loose copy is gone; the same bytes are kept in the Tuldok project's store on the machine that trained the models. Its files sat in: ; project-guided-01; project-guided-pressure-01.

earlier_work.reason: There is no single command line for it: it took one packing command and then several project scripts. The account is in the description.
